## 描述

Spin-on hydraulic filter for Bobcat skid-steer loaders, OE P177047 / 1G-8878 / 6668819. The source confirms the Bobcat references and the skid-steer application but publishes no pressure, micron or flow figure. A spin-on hydraulic element is thread- and pressure-specific, so fitment and duty are the gating variables. Our advice is to supply flow rate and operating pressure, state the ISO 4406 target, and request pressure-drop and beta-ratio data before ordering.
